name: Banshee
description: A banshee has one target to kill and will not rest otherwise!
identifiers: • Will target one player at a time.
ability: Will do a unique banshee scream on the parabolic microphone!

name: Demon
description: One of the most aggressive ghosts!
identifiers: • Will do a lot more hunts than others
ability: Can do a hunt at any % sanity.

name: Deogen
description: A deogen is a speed demon when far, a snail demon when near!
ability: Can produce a unique response through the Spirit Box

name: Goryo
description: Will only show on it's biggest love: The camera!
identifiers:
• Cant wander far from
it's room or change it.

name: Hantu
description: Thrives in the coldest climates!
identifiers:
• Moves quicker in colder
areas during hunts
ability: Could have freezing breath during hunting.

name: Jinn
description: A deogen is a speed demon when far, a snail demon when near!
identifiers:
• Will chase at higher
speed when further away.
properties: • The fuse box is turned on.
ability: If the fuse box is on and the Jinn uses it's ability it can zap sanity from all players in the room or 3 meters witin it by 25%. If it used it's ability it will produce an EMF 2/3 near the breaker.

name: Mare
description: The ghost that loves the dark!
identifiers:
• When roaming it will rather roam to
unlit rooms.
ability: A mare may turn off a light when within 4 meters of a player. The ability has a 10 seconds cooldown which gets reset when turning a light, spammies won't work ;)

identifiers:
• The fastest ghost in the game.
(in line of sight)

name: Myling
description: Talkative on Parabolic Microphone but very quiet when hunting.
identifiers:
• If footsteps are audible only
when equipment starts flickering
It may be a Myling.

properties:

(Than usual 2 minutes)

• 80% Chance to leave fingerprint
(Opposed to the usual 100%)
ability: Has a 1/15 (6.67%) chance to blink in a different ghost model while hunting.  Guaranteed to happen at least once per hunt.

name: Oni

properties:
• Double sanity drain when
the player's colliding ghost events.

• Every third flame it blows out
may initiate a hunt.

Will make it disappear

properties:

every 1 to 2 seconds.

• 100% chance to throw an item

name: Raiju

properties: • When in line of sight: 3 m/s
